estate_label: Sanctions, export controls, and foreign-investment estate
domain: sanctions designations, export restrictions, denied parties, licenses, foreign-investment review, ownership, and national-security controls
scope: OFAC and UK sanctions designations, U.S. consolidated screening lists, BIS export-control restrictions, licenses and enforcement, CFIUS public actions and annual reports, UK National Security and Investment Act decisions, foreign ownership, transaction parties, controlled technologies, and explicit no-match controls. The estate preserves list version and effective date.
why_new_estate: Defense, capital, offshore, AI, and industrial-policy work repeatedly crosses foreign ownership and controlled technology without one corpus for the legal control instruments.

denominator_contract.unit: one exact legal entity, controlled transaction, designation, license, enforcement matter, or published review action
denominator_contract.inclusion_rule: Versioned official lists, Federal Register instruments, enforcement documents, public decisions, annual reports, transaction filings, and exact identifiers.
denominator_contract.exclusion_rule: Fuzzy name-only screening, nationality inference, unpublished CFIUS review treated as a negative, or designation treated as conviction.
denominator_contract.time_window: historical through 2026-07-23, with each source query recording its own bounded window
required_null_controls: exact screened entity absent from versioned list

source_routes.authority: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
source_routes.bounded_output: Sanctions-list identifiers, programs, aliases, entity types, dates, and list changes.
source_routes.residual_fog: Name similarity is insufficient; official IDs, dates, program scope, removals, and ownership rules must be resolved.

source_routes.bounded_output: Consolidated party screening across U.S. export and sanctions lists with source-list, names, addresses, IDs, dates, and remarks.
source_routes.residual_fog: Screening output requires exact entity resolution and source-list verification; fuzzy matches and list absence are not dispositive.

source_routes.bounded_output: Current UK sanctions designations with unique IDs, regimes, names, aliases, addresses, designation dates, and measures.
source_routes.residual_fog: List versions and delistings must be preserved; name matches require exact identity, and the list does not cover non-sanctions controls.

source_routes.authority: U.S. Department of Commerce Bureau of Industry and Security
source_routes.bounded_output: Entity, denied-person, unverified and military end-user restrictions, export-control rules, licenses guidance, and enforcement instruments.
source_routes.residual_fog: List membership, license requirement, license outcome, and enforcement disposition are distinct; controlled-item classification remains transaction-specific.

source_routes.bounded_output: Annual aggregate reports, public enforcement notices, regulations, mitigation guidance, presidential actions, and selected transaction material.
source_routes.residual_fog: Transaction-specific information is generally confidential; public records cannot produce a complete transaction denominator or prove no review.

source_routes.authority: UK Cabinet Office / Department for Business and Trade
source_routes.bounded_output: National Security and Investment Act final orders, revocations, annual reports, guidance, sectors, and published transaction outcomes.
source_routes.residual_fog: Most notifications are not transaction-level public records; absence from published decisions is not proof of no review.

source_routes.authority: Office of the Federal Register / GPO
source_routes.bounded_output: Rules, notices, presidential documents, agency identifiers, dates, docket numbers, and document numbers.
source_routes.residual_fog: A notice is not the underlying adjudication, approval, meeting attendance, or contract transaction.

decisive_output: entity- and transaction-level control ledger with exact identifiers, list version, legal authority, effective dates, disposition, license or mitigation, and explicit public-coverage limits
next_acquisition: resolve counterparties and controlled transactions against versioned sanctions, export-control, and foreign-investment instruments
boundaries: A name match, list entry, review, mitigation agreement, blocked transaction, license, and enforcement action are different states. Absence from public CFIUS material cannot establish absence of review.
A surveyed and prepared estate is not an acquired, completed, or finding-bearing estate.
Official source availability is not evidence of a subject overlap.
